<?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$out = '/wordpress/wp-content/plugins/ceypay-payment-gateway/SMOKE_STATUS.txt';
$L = array(); $fail = 0;
function flush_log($out,$L,$fail){ file_put_contents($out, implode("\n",$L)."\nPOLL_STATUS=".($fail===0?'ALL_PASS':"FAILURES_$fail")."\n"); }
function chk(&$L,&$fail,$out,$label,$ok){ if(!$ok){$fail++;} $L[]=($ok?'PASS ':'FAIL ').$label; flush_log($out,$L,$fail); }

// wp_send_json() ends in a bare die() outside an AJAX context, which would kill
// the process instead of raising something catchable. Force the AJAX path (the
// real one for this handler) so wp_die() becomes filterable, then convert it
// into an exception so the echoed JSON can be captured per case.
add_filter('wp_doing_ajax', '__return_true');
$thrower = function(){ return function( $message = '', $title = '', $args = array() ) { throw new \RuntimeException('wp_die'); }; };
add_filter('wp_die_handler', $thrower);
add_filter('wp_die_ajax_handler', $thrower);
add_filter('wp_die_json_handler', $thrower);

update_option('woocommerce_currency','LKR');
update_option('woocommerce_ceypay_settings', array('enabled'=>'yes','testmode'=>'no','merchant_id'=>'test-merchant-0001','show_branding'=>'no'));

$gateways = WC()->payment_gateways()->payment_gateways();
$gw = $gateways['ceypay'];

// Stand in for the CeyPay API: record the URL the gateway asks for, and hand
// back whatever the current case wants the API to have said.
$GLOBALS['ceypay_last_url'] = '';
$GLOBALS['ceypay_next'] = array('code'=>200,'body'=>'{"status":"PENDING"}');
add_filter('pre_http_request', function( $pre, $args, $url ) {
  $GLOBALS['ceypay_last_url'] = $url;
  $n = $GLOBALS['ceypay_next'];
  if ( ! empty($n['wp_error']) ) { return new WP_Error('http_request_failed', 'connection refused'); }
  return array('headers'=>array(), 'body'=>$n['body'], 'response'=>array('code'=>$n['code'],'message'=>''), 'cookies'=>array(), 'filename'=>null);
}, 10, 3);

function make_order($txn){
  $o = wc_create_order();
  $o->set_currency('LKR');
  $o->set_total(100);
  $o->update_meta_data('_ceypay_transaction_id', $txn);
  $o->save();
  return $o;
}

function call_status($gw, $order){
  $_POST = array('order_id'=>$order->get_id(), 'order_key'=>$order->get_order_key(), 'security'=>wp_create_nonce('ceypay_status_check'));
  $_REQUEST = $_POST;
  ob_start();
  try { $gw->ajax_check_status(); } catch (\Throwable $e) {}
  $raw = ob_get_clean();
  $p = strpos($raw, '{');
  return ( false === $p ) ? array() : json_decode(substr($raw, $p), true);
}

function is_paid($order_id){
  $o = wc_get_order($order_id);
  return $o->has_status(array('processing','completed'));
}

// --- the polling URL itself -------------------------------------------------
// payment/{id} requires merchant auth; payment/{id}/status is the public
// polling endpoint. A transaction ID with URL-significant characters must not
// be able to reshape the path.
$GLOBALS['ceypay_next'] = array('code'=>200, 'body'=>'{"status":"PENDING"}');
$o = make_order('txn abc/1');
call_status($gw, $o);
$url = $GLOBALS['ceypay_last_url'];
$L[] = "url=$url";
chk($L, $fail, $out, 'polls the dedicated /status endpoint', '/status' === substr($url, -7));
chk($L, $fail, $out, 'transaction id is url-encoded in the path', false !== strpos($url, 'payment/txn%20abc%2F1/status'));

// --- a successful response is trusted ---------------------------------------
$GLOBALS['ceypay_next'] = array('code'=>200, 'body'=>'{"status":"PAID"}');
$o = make_order('txn-paid');
$r = call_status($gw, $o);
chk($L, $fail, $out, 'HTTP 200 PAID reported to the browser', ! empty($r['success']) && 'PAID' === $r['data']['status']);
chk($L, $fail, $out, 'HTTP 200 PAID completes the order', is_paid($o->get_id()));

// --- an error response is not ------------------------------------------------
// The regression this guards: an error body carries its own keys, and a
// 'status' among them must never be read as a payment status.
$GLOBALS['ceypay_next'] = array('code'=>500, 'body'=>'{"status":"PAID","error":"internal"}');
$o = make_order('txn-500');
$r = call_status($gw, $o);
chk($L, $fail, $out, 'HTTP 500 body status ignored, reports PENDING', isset($r['data']['status']) && 'PENDING' === $r['data']['status']);
chk($L, $fail, $out, 'HTTP 500 does not complete the order', ! is_paid($o->get_id()));

$GLOBALS['ceypay_next'] = array('code'=>404, 'body'=>'{"message":"Not found"}');
$o = make_order('txn-404');
$r = call_status($gw, $o);
chk($L, $fail, $out, 'HTTP 404 reports PENDING', isset($r['data']['status']) && 'PENDING' === $r['data']['status']);
chk($L, $fail, $out, 'HTTP 404 does not complete the order', ! is_paid($o->get_id()));

$GLOBALS['ceypay_next'] = array('code'=>200, 'body'=>'{"message":"no status here"}');
$o = make_order('txn-nostatus');
$r = call_status($gw, $o);
chk($L, $fail, $out, 'HTTP 200 without a status key reports PENDING', isset($r['data']['status']) && 'PENDING' === $r['data']['status']);
chk($L, $fail, $out, 'HTTP 200 without a status key does not complete the order', ! is_paid($o->get_id()));

// --- transport failure -------------------------------------------------------
$GLOBALS['ceypay_next'] = array('wp_error'=>true);
$o = make_order('txn-wperror');
$r = call_status($gw, $o);
chk($L, $fail, $out, 'transport failure returns an error, not a status', isset($r['success']) && false === $r['success']);
chk($L, $fail, $out, 'transport failure does not complete the order', ! is_paid($o->get_id()));

// --- a webhook that already settled the order still wins ---------------------
$GLOBALS['ceypay_next'] = array('code'=>500, 'body'=>'{"error":"internal"}');
$o = make_order('txn-webhook');
$o->update_status('processing');
$r = call_status($gw, $o);
chk($L, $fail, $out, 'locally paid order reports PAID despite a failed status call', isset($r['data']['status']) && 'PAID' === $r['data']['status']);

flush_log($out, $L, $fail);
